record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:159 — EventManager is built from the caller's credentials rather than the booking organizer's, so when an attendee or team admin adds guests the calendar update fails or targets the wrong account.

adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the handler explicitly allows non-organizers to add guests (permission check allows isAttendee or team admin/owner), but then builds the EventManager from the caller (`const credentials = await getUsersCredentials(ctx.user); const eventManager = new EventManager({ ...user, credentials })`). The booking organizer is separately loaded (`organizer = await prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow({ id: booking.userId })`) and `booking.user` (including credentials) is fetched but never used for EventManager. This means when an attendee/admin triggers the mutation, `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` will run under the caller’s calendar credentials instead of the booking organizer’s, plausibly failing to update the organizer’s calendar event or updating the wrong account.
